label: API/Webhook
description: Executes an HTTP request to an API endpoint or webhooks

label: OpenAI/LLM
description: Send a prompt to an OpenAI-compatible API and return the completion text

label: Condition
description: Evaluates a value against a chosen operator and halts the workflow if the condition is not met.

label: Set Variable
description: Set a global variable that can be accessed across workflows using the syntax {{globals.key}}

label: Trello Create Card
description: Creates a new card on a Trello board list.

label: Action
description: Perform an action on the current browser page.

label: Confluence Page
description: Updates Confluence page via the REST API

label: Gmail
description: Sends emails or saves drafts to Gmail.

label: Google Docs
description: Append text to or reads content from a Google Doc

label: Google Sheets
description: Append a row to or reads content from a Google Sheet

label: HubSpot Blog Post
description: Update HubSpot CMS blog posts via the CMS API

label: Jira Comment
description: Adds a comment to the Jira issue.

label: Jira Create Issue
description: Creates a new issue in Jira (e.g. Task, Bug, Story).

label: Microsoft Excel
description: Append rows to an Excel table/worksheet and retrieve cell/range content.

label: Microsoft Outlook Email
description: Sends an email or saves a draft using Microsoft Outlook.

label: Microsoft Word
description: Append or read content from a Microsoft Word document.

label: Run Workflow
description: Executes another saved workflow and merges its results into the current pipeline.

label: Slack Notification
description: Sends webhook messages to Slack channels
